description.value: Los Cuervos Taqueria & Cantina is an authentic Mexican restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, inspired by the street stalls and cantinas of Mexico and using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The menu spans signature tacos and burritos to weekend brunch dishes like Huevos Rancheros, alongside handcrafted cocktails and margaritas. Cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or a quick online order can also pick up take-home taco and margarita kits.
